objectRequest.name: Picker's Hollow - Salvage Welding Helmet - male
objectRequest.description: One standalone EMPTY welding helmet, South/front view in a cozy low-top-down pixel-art salvage RPG. Retro industrial rounded rectangular rust-orange steel shell, lowered full-face shield, small dark horizontal rectangular green-black glass viewing slit, charcoal rim and side hinges, simple warm highlights and very restrained wear. Enclosed head shell with curved crown, no exposed face. Recognizably a practical welding helmet, not a space helmet, knight helmet, gas mask or robot head. Shared design across body variants; male head fit: slightly broader straight cheek walls. Crisp single-pixel dark outlines and broad quiet color clusters, no noisy scratches, text, logos, glowing eyes, ornaments or extra gear. Helmet alone, no person, mannequin, neck, body, jacket, ground or shadow. Transparent 48x64 canvas. This is an object design reference, actual native head fitting follows separately.

style_image.usage_description: Match the game's pixel grid, outline thickness and restrained shading. Helmet only; do not draw the person.

reference_image.usage_description: Fit this body's welding helmet to the existing head, preserving the exact body. Reference is a design only, not an image to paste or recenter.

fitRequest.description: Add ONLY the reference's rust-orange industrial welding helmet to this exact male South-facing standing body. Helmet encloses the existing bald head without moving/resizing/redrawing anatomy: around x16..32, crown near y5..6, chin shield near y23..24. Original head remains its current size/position under the helmet. Keep the helmet small and proportional, about 18 pixels wide and 19 pixels high, no giant head. Front faces the camera symmetrically: curved crown, rounded rectangular rust-orange shell, dark charcoal rim, small dark horizontal green-black rectangular glass slit, subtle side hinge hardware. Visor fully DOWN and opaque: conceal eyes, eyebrows, face and scalp with the shell/glass, no human eyes showing through. Lower edge above the shoulders, neck/collar visible below; no shoulder pads or bib. Match reference design, restrained solid pixel clusters and crisp one-pixel outline, no texture noise or glow. ALL body pixels below y25, shoulders, torso, underwear, arms/hands, legs/feet remain exact and uncovered. Do not add clothing, hair, tools, background, shadow, expressions or new pose. Keep exact transparent 48x64 canvas and ground pivot (24,58). Output a full fitted source for helmet-only extraction onto the unchanged original body.
